caseName: Philadelphia, Baltimore & Washington Railroad v. Tucker
caseNameFull: The Philadelphia, Baltimore & Washington Railroad Company, in Error v. Lillian Tucker, Administratrix of the Estate of Sydney R. Tucker
disposition: Motion to dismiss or affirm submitted May 15, 1911.
summary: Error to the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. John Spalding Flannery and Mr. William tiitz for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Levi H. David and Mr. Alvin L. Newmyer for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam,

The judgment is affirmed with costs. El Paso & N. E. Ry. v. Gutierrez, 215 U. S. 87; Chicago, B. & Q. R. R. Co. v. McGuire, 219 U. S. 549.
